decision: No package metadata write gate yet. Configuration Packages remain a plausible Business Central implementation route for structured setup data, but the current playthru UI evidence did not prove the Konfigurationspakete page/list surface. The next practical step is a materially different read-only route recovery, not creating a package.
businessCentralConsultantAssessment: For a realistic customer project, configuration packages can be appropriate for structured setup or migration data, especially when repeated manual grid edits are fragile.
However, package metadata is an admin setup artifact. Creating it before a reliable page/list proof would turn a navigation blocker into a write action without enough UI truth.
The existing Foundation field map remains useful as planning input, but planned fields are not saved setup values.
